description: Record on the research report that you are fixing a finding (status fixing, once the user approved the change) or have fixed it (status fixed, with the files, a one-sentence summary for the team, and the pull request link if any). If the last fix of this finding is already live on the site, this starts the next fix (fix 2, 3 …); otherwise it adds to the current one. The report compares people after each fix goes live with the version right before it.

audience.description: Which report: virtual users (default) or real people

files.description: Repository paths of the files changed (or to be changed)

prUrl.description: Pull request link, if one was opened

research.description: The research id, or its name as the user said it (the server finds it by name; if several or none match, it lists them — ask the user which one)

summary.description: One sentence for the team: what visitors now see differently

name: report_fix
